anchor_statement: dev-sanity must spawn the sanity-stack subagent for the link whenever more than one sanity task is open (or its own inline link failed), one spawn at a time in verdict order; each spawn handles exactly one next-top layer and the close procedure runs only after it returns stacked.

cases.text: With three sanity tasks open dev-sanity spawns sanity-stack for the first PASS, waits for stacked, then spawns it for the next; each spawn links one layer.
dev-sanity spawns one sanity-stack per PASS in parallel, or one spawn links several layers at once.

If two or more sanity tasks are open, or its own link attempt failed, dev-sanity hands the link to the sanity-stack subagent: it spawns one at a time in the order the verdicts arrived, each spawn links a single next-top layer, and dev-sanity runs the close procedure only after the spawn returns stacked.
